image_description: A close-up view of a steep, light-colored rock cliff face under bright sunlight. The rock appears to be limestone or chalk, characterized by a rough, weathered texture with visible vertical striations and erosion patterns. Patches of green vegetation, including small bushes and grasses, cling to the top edge and various ledges of the cliff. The sky in the upper left corner is clear blue.

Slight softness/haloing around the leaves of the topmost bushes against the blue sky, suggesting minor segmentation or generation blur.
